description: This Java class 'RecurringDepositProductHelper' provides utility methods for creating, retrieving, and managing recurring deposit products within the Fineract core banking system. It includes functions for building JSON payloads for product creation, handling different chart slabs, and interacting with the API endpoints related to recurring deposit products.

classes.name: RecurringDepositProductHelper
classes.description: Helper class for building, creating, and retrieving recurring deposit products via Fineract API. Contains methods for constructing product JSON payloads, managing interest chart slabs, and handling API interactions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string representing a recurring deposit product with specified validity dates.

methods.name: withAccountingRuleAsNone
methods.description: Sets the accounting rule to 'None' for the deposit product.

methods.name: withAccountingRuleAsCashBased
methods.description: Configures the deposit product with cash-based accounting rule and associated accounts.

methods.name: withPeriodRangeChart
methods.description: Sets chart slabs to a predefined period range configuration.

methods.name: withPeriodAndAmountRangeChart
methods.description: Sets chart slabs to a combination of period and amount range configuration.

methods.name: withAmountRangeChart
methods.description: Sets chart slabs to an amount-only range configuration.

methods.name: withAmountAndPeriodRangeChart
methods.description: Sets chart slabs to a configuration based on amount and period range, with primary grouping by amount.

methods.name: withWithHoldTax
methods.description: Enables tax withholding and sets the tax group ID.

methods.name: createRecurringDepositProduct
methods.description: Performs a POST request to create a new recurring deposit product using the provided JSON payload.

methods.name: retrieveAllRecurringDepositProducts
methods.description: Performs a GET request to retrieve all recurring deposit products.

methods.name: getRecurringDepositProductById
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info of a specific recurring deposit product by ID, returned as a custom response object.

methods.name: retrieveRecurringDepositProductById
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info of a specific recurring deposit product by ID, returned as a HashMap.

methods.name: getInterestRateChartSlabsByProductId
methods.description: Retrieves interest rate chart slabs for a specific product ID.

methods.name: constructChartSlabWithPeriodRange
methods.description: Builds a list of chart slabs based on period ranges with predefined interest rates.

methods.name: constructChartSlabWithPeriodAndAmountRange
methods.description: Builds chart slabs based on combined period and amount range criteria.

methods.name: constructChartSlabWithAmountAndPeriodRange
methods.description: Builds chart slabs based on amount and period range, with primary grouping by amount.

methods.name: constructChartSlabWithAmountRange
methods.description: Builds chart slabs based solely on amount ranges.

methods.name: getAccountMappingForCashBased
methods.description: Constructs account mappings required for cash-based accounting rule; deprecated.
